decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Heritage Statement and Planning Statement prepared by Pelican Architecture and Design Ltd received on 27/01/2017. SH/01 Rev A, SH/02 Rev A, SH/03 Rev A and SH/04 Rev A received on 15/03/2017. Design and Access Statement Rev A prepared by Pelican Architecture and Design Ltd received on 16/03/2017.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall, as far as practically possible, be carried out with the re-use of the original bricks (both whole and part bricks), in accordance with the approved Design and Access Statement.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of the rebuilding stage, a sample panel of 0.5m2 utilising the new brick shall be constructed adjacent to the original wall and photographs shall be submitted to the Local Authority for Approval. No rebuilding shall commence until approval has been given in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The use of any new brick shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 5 - The lime-mortar shall match the original with regard to composition/mixture and colour (when dried).
Condition : 6 - The pointing shall match that of the original wall.

Condition : 7 - The stone used in the pier caps hereby approved shall be natural stone, to match those in the original wall. Prior to their use, a sample of the proposed stone shall be photographed adjacent to the original and submitted to the Local Authority for Approval. The use of any stone shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Demolition and rebuilding of a section of garden wall surrounding the listed building
